turns.replyText:
Honestly, is the pricier one worth the extra, or is the cheaper one fine?
Both options offer great value, but whether the pricier one is worth the extra cost comes down to your personal needs.
The cheaper option, the Small Alchemist Terrarium Starter Kit with Baby Moss Ball Pet ($18.00), is completely fine if you only want a single terrarium for yourself. It includes the glass bottle, decorative gems, accessories, and a live baby marimo moss ball pet, making it a fully functional, beautiful setup right out of the box with no extra purchases needed.
The pricier option, the Small Alchemist Terrariums Set of Two ($36.00), is worth the extra amount primarily if you plan to give one away as a gift or if you want to display two terrariums together in your space. At $18.00 per set, you are not paying a premium per item—you are simply buying twice as much.
If money is tight and you just want one setup for yourself, the single Small Alchemist Terrarium Starter Kit with Baby Moss Ball Pet is more than enough!
